'''Redlake''' was a farming village located to the north of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]], on the border of the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. [[Aimee Kraeff]] was born and raised in this village, twenty years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Slavery/Legends|Slavers]] from the [[Rusty Reach]] raided the village and enslaved its fifty residents to sort scrap.<ref name="MPQ" />
